source_text: Caveat lector: commentarius Rufini superstites ad Cant. 2:15 desinit; Homiliae in Isaiam in Baehrens sequuntur. Nuptialia spiritaliter de Verbo/anima vel Christo/ecclesia. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
pass_a_gloss: Let-beware reader: commentary of-Rufinus surviving at Song 2:15 ends; Homilies on Isaiah in Baehrens follow. Nuptial-things spiritually concerning Word/soul or Christ/church. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
pass_b_english: Let the reader beware: Rufinus’s surviving commentary ends at Song 2:15; Baehrens next prints the Homilies on Isaiah. Take the nuptial words spiritually of the Word and the soul, or of Christ and the church. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
